review.reasoning: The candidate README is factually accurate, complete, specific to this real product, and ready to ship as-is. Every concrete claim is traceable to the supplied ProductFacts: the product identity, audience, problems solved, capabilities (including verified formats), installation coordinates, verified acquisition from Maven Central, minimal compiled example, license, release state, limitations, compatibility, and support/documentation links. The README preserves valuable original content (e.g., API compatibility notes, project status, building instructions, contributing, resources). It follows the presentation plan and product-first ordering (audience, problem, capabilities, installation, usage, etc.) before commercial links. The verified example is correctly presented and matches the source build. The 'Known limitations' section explicitly includes the repository-verified limitation about rendering and commercial-API parity. No unsupported claims, generic boilerplate, or promotional content crowding out product substance is present. All links are real, relevant, and correctly targeted per the documentation.links and support.routes facts.
